context.input: admitted observation/evidence references and read-only projections

field_event.role: candidate event boundary for field-relevant observations
field_event.input: observation/evidence refs plus explicit field scope and temporal fields

current_world.role: derived candidate representation for Cognitive State Formation
current_world.input: Context candidate plus Field State references and observation lineage

boundary_rule: Context must not become a second Field State writer, and Current World must not bypass Field Event Admission or Field State Reducer.
